messages:
zoe: short decision thread: customers want route cost, a tiny trace hook to link into tracing, and better error grouping. need a quick scope pick for next sprint.

harry: propose Compact scope: dashboards + route cost (best-effort) + trace hook API + basic error grouping. hits most asks without billing infra.

leah: agree. launch criteria: dashboards in prod, cost widget with confidence band, trace hook API documented with SDK snippet, error grouping reduces noise by >=50% in canary.

zoe: telemetry guardrail: default sampling 0.5%. Dedicated can raise to 5% via toggle with projected token delta shown. cap raw retention to 7d.

harry: runtime tasks: emit {route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out} and attach header when sampled. pseudocode: `if(sampled){ headers['x-rw-span']=spanId }`.

leah: canary plan: 4 customers for 10 days (mix PLG/growth/dedicated). abort if token delta > 35% or dashboard latency p95 > 250ms.

zoe: owners: Product=zoe, Runtime=harry, Platform=leah. infra-bot will post canary alerts. action items: harry open PR; leah create dashboard ticket; I'll draft UI copy. react to confirm.

harry: :thumbsup:

leah: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: CANARY SCHEDULED start=1770180000 duration=10d. will post daily checks.
